caveats: Experimental joint method/time probabilities, rescaled to the existing frozen winner probabilities. Not a certified prop model or demonstrated betting advantage.
Probability calculations are conditional on a decisive KO/TKO, submission, or points outcome; draw, no-contest and disqualification probabilities are not modeled.
Points and full distance are separate outcomes. Early technical decisions do not count as full distance.
Within-round timing uses empirical historical finishing times with weight-class pooling, not a uniform-time assumption.
Research total thresholds are not asserted to be offered FanDuel lines.
No cached search-engine price is presented as a current FanDuel offer. No expected-value claim without a verified quote.
Every fight is retained. This replay occurs after the card began, does not consume today’s fight outcomes, and is not an in-fight forecasting model.
Totals and distance displayed for both fighters refer to shared fight outcomes, not independent wagers.
